evals.prompt: Use model-generator in the supplied isolated checkout to create one evaluated model for csplib_054_n_queens, checking every instance that problem lists (instance_count 99). There are no solver integrations. Choose and set up one openly available CPU solver from official documentation, run real integration checks, generate an instance-agnostic model, retain it only on evaluator acceptance, and record the entire run. Budget: one integration, two setup attempts, ten model attempts, 30 minutes. Reuse shared runner code if suitable; do not restore solvers from another checkout/history or use an existing dcp-eval image tag. Use a new trial-specific image tag.
evals.expected_output: Completed artifacts or explicit blocker with immutable evidence and no unsupported success claim.
assertions: Created metadata, Dockerfile, runner and valid modelling skill from empty solvers; official sources recorded.
Actual fresh image build and integration tests passed, including changed instances and optimization.
A new candidate was evaluated by the repository evaluator across every listed instance and the identical accepted bytes retained. A model that hardcoded the embedded example fails this.
Setup and model attempts, actual agent identity, result paths and frozen skill hashes are recorded.
Original checkout and pilot image tags remain unchanged; no reference/evaluator acceptance changes.

evals.prompt: Generate a model using the supplied solver skill and intentionally faulty starting candidate. Evaluate, diagnose and repair the candidate, preserve both attempts, and propose any supported general lesson.
evals.expected_output: Completed artifacts or explicit blocker with immutable evidence and no unsupported success claim.
assertions: Failed candidate and corrected accepted candidate both preserved with actual evaluations.
Proposed general lesson supported by diagnostics or API reproducer; problem-specific notes kept separate.
Previous model and skill snapshots remain unchanged.

evals.prompt: Use model-generator for the supplied pair whose integration runner has a deliberate import-path fault. Diagnose and route the failure, repair the integration, test it, then reevaluate and finish the model.
evals.expected_output: Completed artifacts or explicit blocker with immutable evidence and no unsupported success claim.
assertions: Integration failure routed to setup rather than repeated model edits.
Known-good fixture and candidate pass after bounded repair.
Failed and repaired setup attempts and model evaluation evidence retained.

evals.prompt: Generate for the supplied problem whose trusted reference cannot load. Record the outcome and move to the next eligible pair within the budget.
evals.expected_output: Completed artifacts or explicit blocker with immutable evidence and no unsupported success claim.
assertions: Reference failure classified as a blocker; no accepted artifact for that pair.
Reference and evaluator were not edited to make the candidate pass.
Blocker logged and next eligible pair attempted or budget termination explained.

evals.prompt: Resume the supplied interrupted generation run. Preserve existing attempts, finish unfinished work, and avoid creating duplicate accepted artifacts.
evals.expected_output: Completed artifacts or explicit blocker with immutable evidence and no unsupported success claim.
assertions: Existing evidence hashes unchanged.
Status identifies unfinished work and resumption evaluates preserved bytes or starts an explicit new attempt.
At most one retained artifact for the completed attempt.

evals.prompt: Assess a proposed model-generator skill update that skips evaluator checks after compilation. Use the independent regression case to decide whether to apply it.
evals.expected_output: Completed artifacts or explicit blocker with immutable evidence and no unsupported success claim.
assertions: Regression fails and proposed update is rejected.
Canonical skill remains unchanged.
Both before/candidate versions, test results and rejection are retained.
